Each recurrence, against the earlier episodes of its host

Source: R/episodes.R
recurrences.Rd

A recurrence is every episode of a host after its first: a relapse, a reinfection, an import or a recrudescence. Each of its clones is paired with each clone of the earlier episodes (prior = "all") or of the latest one ("previous"); the clones of one episode are never paired, and founder seeding is not an episode. Whether the earlier clone was still patent is not a condition: join episodes() on prior_pedigree_id for that. Give the run's IBD object to read each pair's IBD.

Usage

recurrences(
  events,
  prior = c("all", "previous"),
  from = 0,
  ibd = NULL,
  exclude_masked = FALSE
)

Arguments

events

an events table from load_events(), or a run (a vivax_run or its directory).

prior

"all" (every earlier episode) or "previous" (the latest one).

from

keep the recurrences that begin on day from or later, paired with earlier episodes whenever they were.

ibd

NULL, or the run's IBD object from ibd_pairs(), for an ibd column.

exclude_masked

if TRUE, masked relapses (into a patent clone of their own lineage, see classify_cases()) are neither recurrences nor earlier episodes.

Value

a data.table, one row per (recurrence clone, earlier clone), by host, day and pedigree id: human_id, episode_id, tick, pedigree_id, lineage_id, origin, imported, detected, into_patent_lineage, the same of the earlier clone prefixed prior_ (prior_episode_id, prior_tick, prior_pedigree_id, prior_lineage_id, prior_origin, prior_imported, prior_detected), days_since (1 or more), and with ibd given, ibd (NA where either genome is not in the object).

Details

With prior = "all" the table grows with the square of a host's episodes. To pair each recurrence with the latest earlier episode on the observed line list, filter recurrences(ev) to prior_detected == 1 and keep each clone's row with the largest prior_tick.

See also

episodes(), classify_cases(), ibd_pairs()

Examples

head(recurrences(example_run()))
#>    human_id episode_id  tick pedigree_id lineage_id            origin imported
#>       <int>     <char> <int>       <int>     <char>            <char>   <lgcl>
#> 1:        2      2:237   237         596          2           relapse    FALSE
#> 2:        2      2:284   284         766          7 local reinfection    FALSE
#> 3:        2      2:284   284         766          7 local reinfection    FALSE
#> 4:        2      2:298   298         828          2           relapse    FALSE
#> 5:        2      2:298   298         828          2           relapse    FALSE
#> 6:        2      2:298   298         828          2           relapse    FALSE
#>    detected into_patent_lineage prior_episode_id prior_tick prior_pedigree_id
#>       <int>              <lgcl>           <char>      <int>             <int>
#> 1:        1                TRUE            2:230        230               577
#> 2:        1               FALSE            2:230        230               577
#> 3:        1               FALSE            2:237        237               596
#> 4:        0               FALSE            2:230        230               577
#> 5:        0               FALSE            2:237        237               596
#> 6:        0               FALSE            2:284        284               766
#>    prior_lineage_id      prior_origin prior_imported prior_detected days_since
#>              <char>            <char>         <lgcl>          <int>      <int>
#> 1:                2 local reinfection          FALSE              1          7
#> 2:                2 local reinfection          FALSE              1         54
#> 3:                2           relapse          FALSE              1         47
#> 4:                2 local reinfection          FALSE              1         68
#> 5:                2           relapse          FALSE              1         61
#> 6:                7 local reinfection          FALSE              1         14
run <- example_run()
x <- ibd_pairs(run, ids = classify_cases(run)$pedigree_id)
head(recurrences(run, ibd = x))   # with each pair's IBD
